Vacancy for various posts
Tuesday, 28 November 2023
7761 Hits
Applications on plain paper enclosed with the certified photocopies of the educational qualification and experience are invited for the below mentioned posts which must reach to the Dean, Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, Po. Sevagram, Dist. Wardha 442102 / Medical Supdt., Kasturba Hospital, Po. Sevagram, Dist. Wardha 442102 latest by
18/12/2023
.
Registration with Local Employment Exchange is mandatory for Sr. No.2 to 7 and Sr. No.10 to 14, copy of the same to be submitted along with application
.
Tutor – 5 Posts
Qualification & Experience: M.Sc.
in Medical Microbiology, Medical Anatomy or MBBS from a recognized Institute
Cashier
: 1 Post (Open)
Qualification & Experience:
Degree in Commerce from a recognized University or equivalent, proficiency in computer applications with at least 2 years’ experience as Cashier / Accounts Clerk in a Medical College or 500 beded hospital.
Health Educator – 1 Post (Open)
Qualification & Experience
– Graduation from recognized Institute / University with Diploma in Health Education/ Certificate course in Health Education from a recognized University / Institute.  Candidate with experience in Medical Institute with more than 500 beds will be preferred.
Mechanic : 1 Post (Open)
Qualification & Experience:
SSC and Regular ITI in Repairs & Rewinding of Electric Motor of Directorate of Technical Education from Govt. approved Institute with Industrial experience of at least five years of all electrical motor maintenance, motor starter maintenance, ceiling fan maintenance and knowledge of generator maintenance.
Carpenter : 1 Post (Open)
Qualification & Experience:
SSC and Diploma or Certificate in Carpentry from Govt.  approved Institute or ITI (one year) with experience of at least one year with an organization having annual turnover of Rs.50.00 lacs.
Plumber : 1 Post (Open)
Qualification & Experience:
SSC with ITI (one year) from Directorate of Vocational Education & Training (Maharashtra State) or equivalent.  Candidate must have 2 years’ Experience in the field at reputed organization or with A/B Class Contractor.
Mason: 1 Post (Open)
Qualification & Experience:
SSC with experience of construction field for at least 5 years in a Construction Company or with A/B Class Contractor.
Occupational Therapist – 1 Post (Open)
Qualification & Experience:
Bachelor of Occupational Therapy preference will be given to the candidates having certificate course in Neuro Psychiatry / orthopedics with minimum 1 year experience or more in a large hospital (300 beded or more).
Dietician – 1 Post (Open)
Qualification & Experience:
B.Sc. Home Science with Post Graduate Diploma in Dietetics from a recognized Institute / University with minimum 3 years’ experience or more as Dietician in a hospital with 300 or more beds.
Dialysis Technician – 1 Post (Open)
Qualification & Experience:
B.Sc. (Dialysis Technology) from a recognized Institute / University with 3 years or more experience in a hospital with 300 beds or more.
Dialysis Assistant – 1 Post (Open)
Qualification & Experience:
HSSC, Degree / Diploma (Dialysis Technology) from a recognized Institute / University with 1 year or more experience in a hospital with 300 beds or more.
Dental X-Ray Assistant – 1 Post (Open)
Qualification & Experience:
HSSC Science (with Physics, Chemistry, Biology) and Diploma / certificate course in Radiography from a recognized Institute / University with 1 year or more experience in a hospital with 300 beds or more.  Candidate with degree in Radiography will be preferred.
Cook – 1 Post (VJNT)
Qualification & Experience:
SSC from State / Central Board with 3 years’ experience
as Cook in dietary section in a large hospital with 300 beds or more. Candidate having Diploma / Certificate course in cooking will be preferred.
Attendant: 9 Posts
(1 VJNT, 1 SBC, 1 EWS, 6 Open)
Qualification & Experience:
SSC of State/Central Board with two years’ work experience in a hospital with 300 or more   beds or in Medical College.
Salary:
As per Kasturba Health Society’s Rules
Age Limit
: Between 18 to 38 years for General Candidate/ between 18-43 for reserved candidate
Note:
Applications for the posts mentioned in Sr. No. 1 to 7 should be submitted to the Dean, MGIMS. For the posts mentioned in Sr. No. 8 to 14, applications should be sent to the Medical Superintendent, Kasturba Hospital
Age limit and/or Experience can be relaxed for otherwise qualified candidate.
Number of posts may vary.
Institute reserves the right to adopt varying selection process for different post.
Only eligible candidates will be called for Written / Skill test and shortlisted candidates will be called for document verification / Interview.
Decision of Selection Committee will be final.
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
